summary_1line: Rama leaves Kosala, reaches the Ganga, bids farewell to Ayodhya, and is warmly received by Guha, the ferryman king, while maintaining his ascetic vow.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama stands facing distant Ayodhya with folded hands and tearful eyes, bidding farewell as citizens watch from afar.
The radiant river Ganga flows wide with white foam and lotus flowers while swans glide and forest hermitages line the banks.
Guha the ferryman king bows before Rama in ascetic robes beneath the leafy Ingudi tree beside the Ganga.
